thread:
FinanceOps: Hey team — nightly billing job created ~1500 credit adjustments this morning. Looks like a webhook replay hit the apply-credit worker and double-applied some promo credits. NetSuite batch ID NSBATCH-20240724-17 shows 1.5k credits. Can we triage?
Alex: Ack — I'm looking at the webhook consumer logs now. I see repeated processing of the same Stripe event ids with different delivery attempts. The worker isn't deduping on stripe_event_id.
Maria: Ugh, customers are seeing negative invoices in the dashboard. We need a rollback plan before EOD. Which customers impacted? any big accounts?
Jordan: From quick scan, most are small seats, but two mid-market accounts got prorated credits that pushed them negative. I've flagged them in the ledger.
Sophie: Reproduced locally: webhook service receives same event id twice when Stripe retries and our proxy returns 5xx for the first attempt due to a transient DB connection issue. Our retry logic re-enqueues and then apply-credit runs again.
Alex: Current worker idempotency uses (customer_id, invoice_id) but credits don't always include invoice_id when it's a usage adjustment. Need to add stripe_event_id dedupe column to credits table and reject duplicates.
Maria: Sounds good. Meanwhile can we reverse the phantom credits in NetSuite? Ops won't allow manual reversal at scale without an approved script. I can approve a safe script if you provide steps.
Sophie: Proposed hotfix: update webhook consumer to persist stripe_event_id with unique index and make apply-credit noop if event exists. Patch diff (tiny):
```
# add stripe_event_id to credits
alter table credits add column stripe_event_id varchar(255) null;
create unique index on credits(stripe_event_id) where stripe_event_id is not null;
# worker: before apply -> if exists(stripe_event_id) return
```
I'll open a PR now.
Alex: Also adding a short-lived DLQ for events that cause DB connection errors so retries don't reprocess until infra is healthy. That should prevent big replays during outage windows.
Jordan: CI + one canary deploy to staging then canary to prod for 10% traffic. deploy-bot: deploy started for canary/webhooks 2024-07-24T15:50Z :rocket:
FinanceOps: For rollback, Maria — if you sign off on the reversal script we can run a NetSuite batch to credit-reverse only records with stripe_event_id in the bad set. We'll generate a CSV for accounting.
Maria: Approve — run the script during maintenance window and send audit CSV to accounting. Please include reason and list of NS batch ids.
Sophie: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/482 — patch + migration included. I included migration to backfill stripe_event_id for last 30 days from logs.
Alex: Quick query I used to find duplicates: 
```
select stripe_event_id, count(*) as n from credits where stripe_event_id is not null group by stripe_event_id having n > 1;
```
Found ~1523 duplicates.
Jordan: I'll prepare rollback runbook and schedule NetSuite reversal during 18:00-18:30 PT. Need one ops on-call and one finance approver.
FinanceOps: Thanks — please add the CSV to the ticket. Also, let's add a postmortem: root cause = transient DB errors + non-idempotent consumer. Action items: (1) patch dedupe by event id (Sophie), (2) DLQ/backoff (Alex), (3) reversal script + accounting audit (Jordan/Maria), (4) add alert when credits spike > 500 in window (FinanceOps).
Maria: I'll notify customer success for the two impacted mid-market accounts and prepare messaging. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: canary/webhooks rolled out to 10% successfully at 2024-07-24T16:05Z :white_check_mark:
Sophie: Migration ran on staging. Backfill plan for prod: run migration during maintenance, then backfill 7-day window first, monitor errors for 30m, then backfill 30 days.
Alex: After we confirm no more duplicates, we should reprocess DLQ safely (idempotent), or do a manual apply that checks stripe_event_id.
FinanceOps: Good work. Keep updates in this thread. I'll attach final CSV & postmortem when complete.
